label: Cyclic three-ring families
description: Three cyclic tile orbits with imposed rotation_1 equivariance.

variants.label: Three rings of 3 - parallel / parallel
variants.description: Three 3-cycles with one matching interface between corresponding tiles of adjacent layers.

variants.label: Three rings of 3 - open outer layer / boundary points
variants.description: The outer tiles do not contact each other; each middle tile reaches the disk boundary at the point between two outer arcs, while the two inner layers remain parallel cycles.

variants.label: Three rings of 3 - offset / parallel
variants.description: Offset contacts between the outer and middle layers, parallel contacts between middle and inner layers.

variants.label: Three rings of 3 - parallel / offset
variants.description: Parallel contacts between the outer and middle layers, offset contacts between middle and inner layers.

variants.label: Three rings of 3 - offset / offset, same chirality
variants.description: Both annuli use the same cyclic offset orientation.

variants.label: Three rings of 3 - offset / offset, opposite chirality
variants.description: The inner annulus uses the opposite cyclic offset orientation from the outer annulus.
